The parallel WebSocket chat gate shows the same check treated as blocking, rejecting with 'Insufficient balance to start conversation' (sunona/server.py 548-560).

contracts.protected_resource: The caller organization's billable balance (api_key.organization_id) consumed by WebRTC voice-agent sessions, and the session/assistant-worker resources created via get_webrtc_handler().
contracts.protection_obligation: Billable voice-agent session establishment is gated: POST /webrtc/session must not create a WebRTC session (together with its wired Assistant agent worker) until BillingMiddleware.check_balance passes for the caller's organization_id. Merges the billing components of reviewer obligations 1 and 3 (identical guard site and commit point).
